dot-dash-3d.source: REA capture_browser_scenario, headed Chrome, real GPU (Apple M-series, Metal)
dot-dash-3d.results: Arcade-readability redesign: near-top-down full-maze camera, blue neon wall outlines on near-black, gold courier orb-bot (brightest), four spinning star sentries (red/magenta/cyan/orange) with big eyes, dark-blue frightened state, eyes-only eaten state, warm-white pellets, pulsing power cells. ?autoplay=1 starts by itself and plays (clears pellets, eats surged sentries, loops). Results/game-over card not captured (autoplay rarely loses in 20 s; covered by unit test).
